partner.name: Volyty Pte. Ltd. - Miniso
partner.descriptionHtml:
Established in Tokyo, Miniso was jointly founded by Miyake Junya, the chief designer of MINISO, and Ye Guofu, a young Chinese entrepreneur, with the aim of advocating a fashionable and relaxed lifestyle. Today, Miniso is a global fast fashion designer brand, offering a wide range of products across 10 product categories including lifestyle, home, gifts, and electronics.

Miniso is dedicated to providing customers with quality and creative products at affordable prices; Miniso products are priced from as low as $3. To date, Miniso Singapore operates 27 stores island wide.

Note: Gift cards are issued by Mooments. Direct payment via Kris+ in Miniso stores is not available. Earn or redeem miles via purchase of gift cards only.
